Now I see the flow. The `captured_length` comes from `epb->capture_packet_length` which is a `uint32_t` read from the file. In `light_get_next_packet`, this is assigned to `packet_header->captured_length`. Let me check the type of `captured_length` in `light_packet_header`:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>grep -n "captured_length\|original_length" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/PcapPlusPlus/3rdParty/LightPcapNg/LightPcapNg/include/light_pcapng_ext.h | head -20</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
